hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v eai >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec eai hook claude; elif [ -x "$HOME/.eai/bin/eai" ]; then exec "$HOME/.eai/bin/eai" hook claude; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$1" claude; else exec python "$1" claude; fi' -- "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/eai_hook.py"
